% image-kinds-text — a paragraph set as type and then rasterised, for image-kinds.tex.
%
% Rendered at 200 dpi to image-kinds-text.png, so the only way to read these words in
% image-kinds.pdf is from pixels: no glyph of it reaches the content stream.
\documentclass[border=6pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\begin{document}
\begin{minipage}{9cm}
A paragraph set as an image cannot be read from the file's text, because the file holds
no text for it, only pixels. Read from those pixels, its words belong where it stands.
\end{minipage}
\end{document}
